decision: Select a reproducible factor-data authority for post-publication factor persistence tests without silently mixing CRSP FIZ and CIZ histories.

methodology_transition.before: CRSP Stock and Indexes Legacy Format (FIZ)
methodology_transition.after: CRSP Stock and Indexes Flat File Format 2.0 (CIZ)
methodology_transition.official_statement: FIZ files were discontinued after the December 2024 data release; beginning with the January 2025 data release the Data Library uses CIZ files for US research returns.

material_monthly_return_difference.FIZ: month-to-month holding-period returns with dividends reinvested at month-end
material_monthly_return_difference.CIZ: compounded daily returns with dividends reinvested on ex-dates

evaluation.tested_rule: The repository's frozen 2020 third-party mirror is sufficient as the current authority for factor persistence decisions.
evaluation.reason: The official Data Library now publishes observations through 2026-06 and documents a material CRSP input-format transition beginning with the January 2025 release; the repository mirror ends at 2020-02 and cannot represent current or vintage-aware evidence.
evaluation.alternative_explanation: The mirror can remain useful for reproducing historical repository results because its commit/blob/hash are frozen; this supports retaining it as legacy evidence, not using it as current authority.

invalidation_condition: Re-evaluate this contract if the Kenneth French Data Library changes its archive/vintage policy or publishes a new methodology transition affecting factor histories.
